hook: Signal now blocks AI from reading chats
hookText: Signal now blocks AI from reading chats

beats.say: Signal says privacy is its mission, and it is now restricting the latest AI agents built into mobile operating systems from capturing and storing your Signal data.
It is blocking such capture by preventing screenshots in the app on iOS 27, and when AI assistants attempt to capture screen data on Android.
It has done this before with Windows, and for macOS 27 it recommends adding Signal to the excluded apps in Siri settings.
